Urban Traffic Flow Explorer

Data Exploration and Visualization micro-project. 15,000 sensor records across 12 Chinese cities: check a route, slice the data, run a what-if simulation and read the findings.

Filters

Filters apply to the KPIs, charts, heat map, table and report. The Route check tab always uses the full dataset.

What-if simulator

A textbook model (BPR volume-delay curve), not trained on the dataset. Use it to see how lanes, weather, road works and accidents change flow.
